title: Tabulation width parameter
statement: For a finite type $\kappa$, natural numbers $m,w$, and a function $F$ assigning a Boolean-list transformation to each element of $\kappa$, define the tabulation width parameter as $m$ plus the maximum tabulation gate width for $m,w,F$, plus $w$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ maps each element of $\kappa$ to a function from Boolean lists to Boolean lists.
caveat: The payload does not include the definition of kindWidth, which is used to define the tabulation gate width.
